title: Sieyès embassy: Wessenberg P 1839 5 and the Rivals letter of 10 Oct 1798
correspondents: Talleyrand to Sieyes (Konstanz P 1839 21, Paris 26 Oct 1798, clear text written over the cipher); Sieyes to Talleyrand (probable, P 1839 5, Berlin 17 Jul 1798); AN 284AP/12: Rivals (Cassel, 10 Oct 1798, dechiffrement manque), De Bry, Roberjot, Grouvelle, Parandier
shelfmark: Stadtarchiv Konstanz, Wessenberg correspondence P 1839 5; Archives nationales 284AP/12
folio_note: Konstanz: 1 ciphered letter (26 Oct 1798, 1 p.) and a postscript of ciphered news (17 Jul 1798); AN: letters of 10 and 14 Oct 1798 partly ciphered, decipherment missing
status: 10 Nov 2026 (Brice Dudout, L'Europe chiffrée, issue #382, not checked by the project): Stadtarchiv Konstanz Wessenberg X XVII P16 1839/5 (Berlin 17 Jul 1798) is not an open cipher: the P.S. is a clear copy, with margin notes 'non chiffré' / 'Chiffré'. His test of 1839/21 against a page of clear did not hold (margin -0.05). What stays open is AN 284AP/12 (Rivals, Cassel, 10 Oct 1798, cited by Rivals as 'le déchiffrement manque'); the key to look for is the Berlin legation table in the AE archives. Earlier: Kalliope: 'Chiffrierter Brief mit der Bitte um Auskunft über die Reaktionen in Berlin...'; AN inventory: 'partiellement chiffrée, le déchiffrement manque'. Another Konstanz letter (15 Sep 1798) mentions Grouvelle bringing 'la nouvelle chiffre' for Berlin-Hamburg-Copenhagen-Stockholm. Narrowed to the unread part and restored 2 Nov 2026.
why: The Directory's secret Prussian policy during the Second Coalition, in Sieyès's own papers.
